_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Phase-In Transition Plan
summary: Specifies the format and content for the Phase-In Transition Plan, used to identify tasks, allocated resources, schedule, and risks associated with transitioning into a fully operational aircraft modification and MR&O facility.
use_relationship:
The Phase-In Transition Plan will be used to identify tasks, allocated resources, and schedule and risks associated with the transition into a fully operational facility ready to perform Modifications and Maintenance Repair and Overhaul (MR&O) of aircraft.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: Contractor format is acceptable and must address all requirements listed in section 3 of this DID. The report will be in Microsoft Office 2016 file format (i.e., 2016 Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project) and must be completely accessible (including formulas) to the Government. Forms, letters, and signed documents will be in fully searchable Portable Document Format (.pdf) file. The plan will be free of proprietary markings.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The plan will contain the following:

children.title: Cover Page
children.content: The cover page will contain the following information:

children.title: Title and identification of the system/component/program/project
Date of plan and period covered
Preparing activity and location of the site where prepared
Project Management Schedule Elements
children.content: Project management schedule elements will include:

children.title: Schedule of tasks (including task owners) and any interdependencies
Assigned resources at the lowest level necessary to manage risk and meet the timeline necessary for full performance of the contractual requirements
Gantt chart
children.content: A Gantt chart will be used to illustrate the schedule and will include:

children.title: Risks identified and prioritized, analysis conducted for each, and risk assigned owner(s)
Identified work around plans and work around closure plans, and the constraints for each
Report Preparer
children.content: Name of person(s) preparing report, email, and telephone number(s).

children.title: Appendices
children.content: Include appendices where applicable: tables, references, charts, or other descriptive material. Each appendix will be identified and referenced in the appropriate area of this plan.
